row:
Dr. Charlie Johnson, PT, DPT, OCS a doctor of physical therapy and a board certified orthopedic specialist.
He helps coach & teach people with back, butt, and sciatica pain how to heal themselves naturally using their mind + movement as medicine (without pills, shots or surgery).
After traveling across the country and learning alongside spine/hip surgeons, osteopaths, chiropractors, massage therapists, yoga instructors and other physical therapists- it became clear that healthcare was designed to "fix you".
Whether or not you believe me at the moment, you're not broken and can actually learn how to fix yourself. 

Figure out the cause of your pain without an MRI 👉 DIY Diagnostic Guide - https://www.drcharliejohnsonpt.com/diyguide  Apply to work with me & learn to heal yourself naturally 👉 http://www.drcharliejohnsonpt.com/apply
Subscribe to my channel 👉 https://www.youtube.com/c/physicaltherapyjohnson?sub_confirmation=1
